declarations.name: OcelleBrandMark

members.name: ground
members.description:
The ground the mark sits on: `chrome` for the dark chrome grounds (`color-chrome`, `color-chrome-hover`); absent or
any other value for the main grounds. Reflected.

members.name: tone
members.description:
`mono` paints ring and spot in `currentColor`, the colour of the surrounding text, and wins over `ground`; absent
or any other value paints the variant of `ground`. Reflected.

members.name: label
members.description:
The accessible name of the mark, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as none, and without one the mark is
hidden from the accessibility tree. Not reflected.

declarations.name: OcelleWorkflowLane

members.name: label
members.description:
The lane's title, shown and used as its name, trimmed; empty or whitespace-only counts as absent, and no title is
shown. Not reflected.

members.name: count
members.description:
The count shown after the title with tabular figures, and named after it: a whole number of 0 or more. The
attribute counts when, after trimming, it is decimal digits alone, at most `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`; the
property when it is a safe integer of 0 or more; anything else counts as absent. Not reflected.

members.name: countLabel
members.description:
The count's text in the lane's name, such as "3 work packages", trimmed; the visible count still shows the
number. Used only while a count is shown. Not reflected.

members.name: variant
members.description:
`flat` drops the lane's ground, corners and padding and sets the title and count in small uppercase; absent or any
other value draws the default lane chrome. Reflected.
